scope: Actual System allocator with no meter; two warmups per mode then five alternating pairs. Same 32MiB constant content, private same-directory stage, 0600 file, 64KiB writes, file sync, no-replace link publication, stage cleanup, parent-dir sync and close. Baseline std filesystem happy-path control lacks FD anchoring/replacement checks/checked-close contract and is NOT a fault-equivalent safe alternative. Measures common successful file-component costs, no SSH/network/workspace/thread pool/GUI/presentation; no SFTP regression or package-adoption claim. Native process sampler at 5ms may have too few phase samples for CPU; missing CPU stays null. Includes Rust harness, ignores filesystem cache effects outside process RSS, not a long idle/pressure test.
